meta.title: nmi to mi Converter — Nautical Mile to Mile
meta.description: Convert Nautical Mile (nmi) to Mile (mi) instantly. 1 nmi = 1.1507794 mi. Free, accurate, browser-based.

content.intro: Convert nautical miles (nmi) to miles (mi) instantly. Both measure length, so the relationship is strictly linear: each nautical mile equals 1.1507794 miles. Use the converter above for any value, or read on for the formula, a quick lookup table, and practical tips.
content.result_section: One nautical mile is equal to **1.1507794 miles**. To go the other way, one mile equals **0.86897624 nautical miles**. For everyday use, rounding to 2–4 decimal places is usually enough; for engineering or scientific work, keep the full precision shown by the converter.
content.formula_section:
The conversion is a single multiplication:

> miles = nautical miles × 1.1507794

Worked example — converting 10 nautical miles:

10 × 1.1507794 = **11.507794 mi**.

To invert, divide by 1.1507794 (or multiply by 0.86897624).

- Travel planning where signage and maps use different unit systems.
- DIY and home-improvement projects that mix metric materials with imperial tools.
- Fitness tracking when devices report in one system and goals are set in another.
- Shipping and logistics where weight and dimensions drive cost.
content.tips:
Keep the factor handy: 1 nmi ≈ 1.1507794 mi. For rough mental math, round to the nearest sensible digit.

Mind the units. Nautical Mile and Mile both measure length; squared or cubic variants need a different factor (factor², factor³).

When precision matters (engineering, lab work, dosing), avoid rounding mid-calculation — convert once at the final step using the full factor.
content.faq:
**Q:** How many miles are in 1 nautical mile?
**A:** 1.1507794 miles.

**Q:** What's the formula to convert nmi to mi?
**A:** miles = nautical miles × 1.1507794.

**Q:** How do I convert mi back to nmi?
**A:** Multiply by 0.86897624 (or divide by 1.1507794).

**Q:** Is rounding to 2 decimal places accurate enough?
**A:** For most everyday uses, yes. For scientific or engineering work, use the full precision from the converter.

**Q:** Does this nmi to mi converter work offline?
**A:** Yes — all math runs in your browser, no network required after the page loads.
